Name: 120 Slot Backpack
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
Description
[b]120 Slot Backpack[/b] expands your inventory from the standard 36 slots to [b]120 slots[/b]. It provides a clean, scrollable inventory interface so you can carry more items while farming, mining, fishing, exploring, and adventuring without constantly returning to storage.
Installation Instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download [b]120 Slot Backpack[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Open your inventory and use the scrolling controls to access your additional slots. [/*]
[/list]Main Features
[list]
[*]🎒 [b]120 total inventory slots[/b] [/*]
[*]📜 [b]Scrollable inventory interface[/b] [/*]
[*]🖱️ Scroll through additional inventory rows [/*]
[*]⬆️⬇️ Convenient navigation buttons [/*]
[*]🔧 Works as a standalone SMAPI mod [/*]
[*]⚡ Lightweight and simple [/*]
[*]🌾 Useful for farming, mining, fishing, foraging, and exploration [/*]
[*]📦 No need to constantly return to chests just to empty your inventory [/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/b] [/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.1 or later[/b] [/*]
[*]No additional frameworks or content packs are required.[/*]
[/list]
